item.title: Book Review: Hammerhead Six, Required Reading for Anyone in Uniform
item.description: Hammerhead Six is a hard, practical lesson in how small Special Forces teams won ground in Afghanistan by mastering culture, accountability, and relationships instead of relying on firepower alone. #Headline #SOFREP #Galenfries #RonaldFry #Hammerheadsix #BookReview

item.title: The Last Stand at FOB Blessing How 100 Marines Held Taliban Heartland
item.description: U.S. Marines of India Company, building on earlier 19th Special Forces groundwork, held the knife-edge terrain of Afghanistan’s Pech Valley at FOB Blessing through relentless patrols and sustained combat, proving that small units could pressure Taliban heartland even in the war’s most unforgiving ground. #Headline #SOFREP #Galenfries #Afghanistan #OEF

item.title: Bolduc Brief: Breaking the Silence: The Enduring Stigma Surrounding Mental Health in Military and First Responder Communities
item.description: Despite years of advocacy and awareness campaigns, the stigma surrounding mental health in military and first responder communities remains deeply entrenched, continuing to deter brave men and women from seeking the help they need out of fear for their careers, reputations, and standing among their peers. #Headline #SOFREP DonaldBolduc #22aday #PTSD #Resilience

item.title: Billionaire Bunkers: SOFREP Takes You Inside High-End Prepper Shelters
item.description: In a world where survival is for sale, the ultra-wealthy are cashing in on peace of mind, leaving the rest of us to wonder if luxury bunkers are just another way to buy their way out of the apocalypse. #LuxuryBunkers #SurvivalWealth #PrepperLife #DoomsdayLiving #BunkerLifestyle #ElitePrepper #Headline #Sofrep

item.title: Evening Brief: USS Delaware MedEvac Off Greenland, Mar-a-Lago Shooting, DHS PreCheck Reversal, Hospital Ship Rejected
item.description: A U.S. submarine surfaced off Greenland for an emergency medical evacuation, an armed man was shot after breaching Mar-a-Lago’s perimeter, DHS reversed a TSA PreCheck suspension during the shutdown, and Greenland declined President Trump’s offer of a U.S. hospital ship. #Headline #SOFREP #Galenfries #Greenland #Mercy #TSA #Maralago

item.title: Medal of Honor Monday: Gary Gordon, Delta Force Sniper, Mogadishu, Somalia
item.description: When the second Black Hawk went down and the city closed in, Gary Gordon did not hesitate, he asked to be put on the ground, knowing exactly what it might cost and choosing it anyway. #MedalOfHonorMonday #GaryGordon #DeltaForce #BlackHawkDown #Mogadishu1993 #TaskForceRanger #SpecialOperations #MilitaryHistory #HonorTheFallen #SOFREP

item.title: Sergeant Major (Ret.) Mike Vining: The Quincy, Illinois Terrorist Bombings, 1976
item.description: We drove up to Quincy together to support a campaign stop and left as three men instead of four, after a device that should have gone off the night before waited for Ken Foster the next morning. #EOD #BombDisposal #MikeVining #KenFoster #QuincyIllinois #1976 #ArmyEOD #LineOfDuty #MilitaryHistory #NeverForgotten

item.title: The Bolduc Brief: The U.S. Constitutional Crisis: An Examination of Elites, Accountability, and the Rule of Law
item.description: As the Epstein files unfold and executive power continues to stretch its limits, the real test is whether America’s institutions will enforce the rule of law evenly, or prove that some elites still operate beyond its reach. #BolducBrief #RuleOfLaw #Constitution #Accountability #ExecutivePower #ChecksAndBalances #EpsteinFiles #USPolitics #NationalSecurity #AmericanGovernance

item.title: Evening Brief: Cartel Shockwaves, South China Sea Pressure, and America’s Submarine Strain
item.description: Cartel aftershocks in Mexico, gray-zone pressure in the South China Sea, and submarines stuck in American shipyards all point to the same quiet truth, instability grows fastest where deterrence slips and nobody moves quickly enough to stop it. #EveningBrief #Mexico #CartelViolence #CJNG #SouthChinaSea #China #Philippines #USNavy #Submarines #NationalSecurity
